metadata.description: Professional-grade Agent Skills for Claude Opus 4.8 and Sonnet 5 across nine domains — programming, DevOps, research, business, orchestration, marketing, product, communication, and web automation. Every skill is validated in CI and encodes an enforceable working discipline.

plugins.name: programming-pro
plugins.description: Engineering discipline for Claude: systematic debugging, TDD, safe refactoring, API design, and performance work.

plugins.name: research-pro
plugins.description: Rigorous research workflows: deep multi-source research, fact-checking, literature reviews, and competitive analysis.

plugins.name: automation-pro
plugins.description: Automation that ships: browser automation for any website, resilient scraping pipelines, and scheduled workflows.

plugins.name: business-pro
plugins.description: Operator-grade business analysis: market sizing, business plans, financial models, pitch materials, pricing, and negotiation.

plugins.name: communication-pro
plugins.description: Everyday professional communication done well: technical writing, difficult emails, meeting notes to decisions, and structured presentations.

plugins.name: orchestration-pro
plugins.description: The meta-layer that multiplies every other skill: planning and decomposing complex tasks, self-verifying work before delivery, and building effectively with Claude itself.

plugins.name: marketing-pro
plugins.description: Content and marketing that converts: persuasive copywriting, search-optimized content, and content strategy built on audience and goals.

plugins.name: product-pro
plugins.description: Product craft: UI/UX design principles, writing PRDs that align teams, and prioritizing a roadmap around outcomes.

plugins.name: devops-pro
plugins.description: Ship and run what you build: CI/CD pipelines, containerization, cloud deployment, and infrastructure as code — with safety, rollback, and observability built in.
